revenue_scope: Worldwide: Harvoni plus the authorized generic sold by Gilead's subsidiary Asegua Therapeutics LLC
why_separate: From 2019Q1 the line is relabelled Ledipasvir/Sofosbuvir and its footnote states it consists of sales of Harvoni and of the authorized generic sold by Asegua, which the published figures do not separate, so it is not Harvoni the brand.
notes: Rows 2019Q1 to 2023Q4. From the first-quarter 2024 release Gilead no longer prints the line: ledipasvir/sofosbuvir is named in the footnote of 'Other Liver Disease' together with Hepcludex, Sovaldi, Viread and Vosevi, which is a broader line not included here. The label spacing changes to 'Ledipasvir / Sofosbuvir' from the fourth-quarter 2020 release.
search_log: Pulled data.sec.gov submissions for CIK 0000882095 (recent and older pages); downloaded the Exhibit 99.1 of every Item 2.02 8-K from 2018-02 to 2026-08 (the 2022-02-01 duplicate 8-K from another filer agent and the 2021-01-11 guidance release carry no product table) and parsed the product sales tables.
Downloaded every 10-Q and 10-K filed 2021-02 to 2026-08 and searched the revenue-disaggregation notes for the product; no separate line after the stop dates stated below.
Web search for a partner, licensee or royalty holder printing the product's net sales after the stop (Gilead is sole seller; Atripla JV partner history only in 2010-era 10-K); nothing found.
First-quarter 2019 release (8-K 0000882095-19-000011) is the first with the renamed line; its prior-year column (348) equals the 2018Q1 Harvoni worldwide total.

continuation.evidence: Footnote (3) of the first quarter 2019 release: 'Amounts consist of sales of Harvoni and the authorized generic version of Harvoni sold by Gilead's separate subsidiary, Asegua Therapeutics LLC' on the 'Ledipasvir/Sofosbuvir (3)' lines. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882095/000088209519000011/exhibit991earningspressrel.htm
